Location: New York, NY, Springfield, MA or Boston, MA

The Opportunity

At MassMutual, our mission is to help people secure their future and protect the ones they love. As the impact of our valuation models continues to grow, we're looking for an Axis Modeling Actuary to join our Life Valuation Modeling team and help drive critical financial reporting, valuation, and strategic initiatives across the enterprise.

The Team

The Valuation Modeling Team helps to protect the long-term interests of policyholders by ensuring MassMutual is positioned to meet its future obligations. Responsible for over $100 billion in direct statutory reserves, the team performs statutory, GAAP/LDTI and tax valuation on Par Whole Life, Term, UL and VUL products. Our work affects regulatory compliance, strategic decision-making and inforce management. For those interested in modeling, interpreting, and communicating financial results in a collaborative team environment, this is an exciting role.

The Impact:

• Apply deep modeling expertise to all phases of input, processing, and output of valuation projections in Axis
• Utilize modeling acumen to execute complex projects such as Cash Flow Testing, new product implementations, assumption change, and structural model updates
• Deliver and explain Stat, Tax and GAAP financial results.
• Develop and improve existing control and versioning methodology in valuation models
• Improve efficiency by leveraging communication skills with internal and external technology partners
• Apply knowledge of life insurance products and regulations to navigate complexity, ambiguity, and limitations in valuation software
• Work directly with various audit stakeholders to demonstrate compliance with regulatory and model governance standards
• Demonstrate agility in responding to stakeholder questions and unexpected results, often at times of peak activity and tight deadlines

The Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, data science, computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative or technical field.
• ASA designation
• 4+ years of actuarial experience within insurance, financial services, or a related quantitative field.
• 1+ years of experience with Axis

The Ideal Qualifications

• FSA designation
• 4+ years of experience with Axis, including model leadership or stewardship roles
• Demonstrated accountability and ownership of long-term independent projects
• Proficient with Axis features such as DataLink, investment cells, scenario files, and embedded block processing
• Understanding of modeling infrastructure such as ELink, GridLink, and output databases
• Expertise with identifying multiple solutions to a problem, and developing collaborative solutions to software limitations
• Ability to estimate resource requirements and set expectations with key stakeholders for highly visible projects
• Experience with Principle-Based Reserves, valuation regulations, product design, modeling assumptions, and inforce policy data
• Proficient with model-supported software such as MS Excel and SQL.
• Strong math, analytical and collaboration skills
• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
• Continuous improvement mindset
• Ability to build and maintain strong working relationships across cross-functional groups

What to Expect as Part of MassMutual and the Team

• Regular meetings with the Life Valuation Team
• Focused one-on-one meetings with your manager
• Access to mentorship opportunities
• Networking opportunities including access to Asian, Hispanic/Latinx, African American, women, LGBTQ, veteran and disability-focused Business Resource Groups
• Access to learning content on Degreed and other informational platforms
• Your ethics and integrity will be valued by a company with a strong and stable ethical business with industry leading pay and benefits

MassMutual is an equal employment opportunity employer. We welcome all persons to apply.

If you need an accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us and share the specifics of the assistance you need.

jobs.description: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description The Global FX and Cross-Border Solutions team is charged with leading the strategy, design, build, and commercialization of best-in-class flexible enterprise-wide FX and Cross-Border solutions as we seek to meet the growing and increasingly diversified needs of clients moving funds around the world. What’s it all about? As Senior Multi-Currency Cards Product Manager, Global FX & Cross-Border Issuer Solutions , you will be responsible for defining and executing the roadmap for Visa's multi-currency card capabilities, driving product strategy from concept through execution while partnering closely with technology, operations, regional teams and clients. The successful candidate will combine a deep understanding of multi-currency wallets, cardholder needs and Visa capabilities to develop innovative solutions that help issuers around the world deliver differentiated multi-currency card propositions. Working at the intersection of product strategy, payments, FX and technology, you will translate market opportunities and business objectives into scalable product solutions through detailed requirements, transaction flows, prototypes and technical designs. The role requires strong product thinking and commercial acumen, with the ability to evaluate and prioritise product investments by balancing client needs, cardholder expectations, technical feasibility and strategic objectives. Success in this role requires understanding how consumers increasingly want to hold, manage and spend across multiple currencies, and translating those needs into capabilities that create value for issuers and cardholders alike. This is an opportunity to influence products used by issuers across Visa's global network, helping shape the next generation of multi-currency card experiences and enabling issuers to deliver greater flexibility, transparency and control to globally connected consumers. All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Gen AI tools (e.g. Replit, Copilot, Figma AI, Claude Code etc) to enable everyday work. What we expect of you, day to day. Product Design & Solution Architecture Own the definition and development of customer-centric product and technical requirements for multi-currency card solutions, using AI-powered tools to accelerate product discovery, prototyping, validation and design. Develop a deep understanding of the end-to-end multi-currency solution architecture, including the interaction between systems. Translate cardholder journeys, issuer needs, market opportunities and business objectives into prioritised functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, workflow models, prototypes and scalable solution designs. Map end-to-end transaction flows across authorisation, clearing and settlement. Develop system context diagrams, sequence diagrams, data flows, interface specifications and system interaction models that clearly define component responsibilities, system dependencies and integration requirements. Partner closely with Technology, Processing and Architecture teams to evaluate solution options, understand existing system capabilities and constraints, and assess technical feasibility, scalability, resilience, security and implementation complexity. Engage confidently in detailed technical discussions, challenging assumptions and helping teams make informed architectural decisions and trade-offs across customer experience, issuer integration, platform capability, delivery effort and future scalability. Define integration requirements for issuer processors and multi-currency platforms, including APIs, payment messages, data exchanges, event flows, configuration requirements and operational processes. Identify architecture gaps, upstream and downstream dependencies, data requirements, edge cases and failure scenarios early in the product development lifecycle. Ensure product and technical designs address operational considerations, including monitoring, reconciliation, dispute and exception management, controls, reporting, support models and production readiness. Lead technical discovery workshops, client design sessions, architecture reviews and solution walkthroughs with issuers, processors, technology partners and internal stakeholders. Maintain clear traceability from cardholder and issuer needs through product requirements, technical design, development and testing, ensuring the delivered solution achieves the intended customer and commercial outcomes. Use AI-enabled product and development tools to accelerate requirements analysis, prototype creation, technical documentation and solution validation, while applying appropriate review, governance and judgement. Product Strategy & Portfolio Prioritisation Define the future vision for Visa's multi-currency issuer capabilities and identify opportunities to address emerging cardholder and issuer needs. Partner directly with issuers, fintechs and regional teams to understand evolving multi-currency propositions, customer expectations and competitive dynamics. Identify strategic opportunities through client engagement, market research, competitive analysis and industry developments. Evaluate product initiatives and investment opportunities based on client value, commercial potential, technical feasibility, implementation complexity, scalability and strategic alignment. Develop business cases, market assessments and value frameworks to support investment and prioritisation decisions. Partner with regional, commercial and product teams to gather market insights and validate investment opportunities. Assess build, buy and partner opportunities to address product capability gaps, recommending the optimal approach based on strategic, commercial and technical considerations, and supporting partnership commercials, contracting and execution. Recommend product roadmap priorities, sequencing and investment allocation based on expected business impact, resource constraints and strategic objectives. Support annual planning, portfolio reviews and investment discussions with senior leadership. Monitor product performance, adoption and commercial outcomes, using Gen AI and data-driven insights to refine strategy and prioritise future investments. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Qualifications Strong understanding of the payments ecosystem, including issuer processing, FX mechanics, multicurrency solutions and cross-border transaction flows. Demonstrated experience working with payment processing platforms and technologies, including VIP, BASE II, authorisation, clearing, settlement and transaction lifecycle management. Experience designing and documenting complex solutions through BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process maps, transaction flows and solution design documentation. Experience working with multi-currency, wallet, FX or banking platforms such as Currencycloud is highly desirable. 5-8+ years of experience in product management, technical product management, payments, FX, multicurrency solutions, issuer processing or cross-border payments. Proven ability to gather requirements, solve complex business and technical problems, and translate them into scalable product solutions. Experience partnering with Technology, Processing, Operations and Architecture teams to deliver product enhancements and strategic initiatives. Experience supporting product roadmap development, business case creation, revenue drivers, financial models and portfolio prioritisation. Strong analytical, strategic thinking and prioritisation skills, with the ability to assess opportunities based on client value, commercial impact, technical feasibility and strategic alignment. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both business and technical audiences. Experience working within global, matrixed organisations and collaborating across regional and cross-functional teams. Willingness to travel up to 20% (regional and global). Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

After lunch, you're building a shortlist deck for a new brief that just landed. Late afternoon, you hop on a quick sync with the XCM production team about an upcoming shoot. Talent's team has a rider question and a scheduling wrinkle.
